text: check out the paint pipeline, it seems broken, i saw ur paint on it, i changed the mode to the paint mode and it is now all black

events.text: User explicitly followed up for the paint itself; diagnosis alone was insufficient. Implement the durable selection-fill journal fix, add framework-layer regression coverage, and recover the intact colored engine atlas.

resolution: Root-caused the Paint-mode black reset. Agent Seat selection fills update the live atlas and saved composite base.png, but framework/gpu/3d.zig meshPaintSelection never records those fills in the durable paint_program journal. Paint-mode hydration then correctly restores the dark raster-base.png and replays an empty program, dropping the visible colors. No code or model artifacts were changed; the colorful base.png remains intact and recoverable. The pipeline fix belongs in the native selection-fill path with Zig-layer coverage.
